report_name: IMS Care Center Discloses Patient Data Breach from Email System

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Actor
threat_actors.description: An unauthorized party that gained access to IMS Care Center's corporate email environment in June 2026, leading to a patient data breach by accessing accounts containing personal and protected health information.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: An unauthorized party gained access to certain valid user accounts within IMS Care Center's corporate email system to access sensitive patient data.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Email Collection
attack_patterns.description: The attacker accessed compromised email accounts to collect sensitive patient information, including personal identifiers, Social Security numbers, and protected health information (PHI).

identities.name: IMS Care Center, LLC
identities.description: A large multispecialty medical group based in Phoenix, Arizona, that suffered a data breach of its corporate email environment, exposing patient personal and protected health information (PHI).

indicators.name: Suspicious Email Forwarding Rule Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Email Forwarding Rule Creation
id: 2b1b8e3a-7c9d-4f8e-8a4b-9d2c1f0e3d5a
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the creation of email forwarding rules to external domains, which can be a sign of data exfiltration or persistence after an email account compromise.
  This was noted as a relevant observable in the IMS Care Center breach investigation.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/ims-care-center-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-21
modified: 2026-10-21
tags:
  - attack.t1114.003
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: audit.exchange
detection:
  selection:
    Operation: Set-Mailbox
    Parameters.Name: ForwardingSmtpAddress
  filter_internal:
    Parameters.Value|contains:
      # Add your internal domains here to filter out legitimate forwarding rules
      - 'internal-domain.com'
  condition: selection and not filter_internal
indicators.description: Detects the creation of email forwarding rules, a common technique for data exfiltration after an email account compromise, as suggested by the 'Email Forwarding Rules' observable in the report.
